    12  # Inertia degree
    13  
    14  Given a prime ideal `q` of an `R`-algebra `S`, the inertia degree of `q` over `R` is defined
    15  to be the degree of the residue field of `q` over the residue field of its preimage `p` in `R`.
    16  
    17  ## Main definitions
    18  
    19  * `Ideal.inertiaDeg q R`: The inertia degree of `q` over `R`.
    20  
    21  ## Main statements
    22  
    23  * `inertiaDeg'_eq_inertiaDeg`: The inertia degree agrees with the usual definition in the case of
    24    maximal ideals.
    25  * `inertiaDeg_tower`: Inertia degree is multiplicative in towers.
    26  -/

    37  /-- Given a prime ideal `q` of an `R`-algebra `S`, the inertia degree of `q` over `R` is defined
    38  to be the degree of the residue field of `q` over the residue field of its preimage `p` in `R`.
    39  
    40  When `q` is not prime, we use a junk value of `0`.
    41  
    42  This will eventually replace the existing definition of `Ideal.inertiaDeg'`. -/

    44    if _ : q.IsPrime then
    45      letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.under R) q

    51      q.inertiaDeg R = Module.finrank (q.under R).ResidueField q.ResidueField := by
    52    convert! dif_pos hq
